name: CF Industries Donaldsonville nitrogen complex
location: Donaldsonville, Louisiana (west bank of the Mississippi River, 1,400 acres)
description: Large nitrogen complex with six world-scale ammonia plants, five urea plants, four nitric acid plants, three urea ammonium nitrate plants and a diesel exhaust fluid plant; the operator quotes nearly 8 million tons of nitrogen products a year depending on product mix.

capacities.basis: annual capacity for agricultural and industrial use, depending on product mix

source.note: CF Industries Donaldsonville Complex page, read 2026-11-17

capacities.basis: reported 2023 direct emissions (metric tons CO2e, AR4 GWP); EPA facility ID 1002301. Reported subparts C, G and V; no subpart PP (CO2 supplied) record in 2023.

source.note: EPA GHGRP 2023 data summary spreadsheets, direct point emitters, read 2026-11-17

sources.note: CF Industries site page for Donaldsonville, read 2026-11-16
CF Industries 'Who We Are' page (2016 expansion added worldscale ammonia, urea and UAN plants at Donaldsonville), read 2026-11-17

source.note: CF Industries site page for Donaldsonville, read 2026-11-16

notes: GCCSI's November 2024 report separately lists a 'CF Industries Donaldsonville' clean-ammonia project (1.2 Mt/yr, 2 Mtpa CO2, in construction) that is distinct from the operating nitrogen complex recorded here.
